name: Dvati
printedArtCredit: Tom Fowler, Dvati portraits on pp. 14 and 16, credited on pp. 15 and 17.
sourceDistinctions: The 2000 AD&D issue has earlier player options and different echo-voice and surviving-twin rules. The 2005 rules and original builds in this batch use D&D 3.5.
Roll each Hit Die once, split the die result and add the full Constitution contribution to each body. Class progression and per-day uses are a single shared resource.
One twin casting alone requires the other to take no actions during the casting. The encounter cards use one shared initiative count as a table ruling.
Pair Link and Echo Attack are distinct. The former requires the twins to flank together or aid one another. The latter spends both move actions and requires a failed Will save.
portraitForm: Aven and Iven Threadwell, an original Dvati Bard pair
